> On the write-order point... storage tries already apply insertions and updates before deletions, so a deletion only collapses a branch that stays collapsed in the post-state. The account trie can only see a deletion in a narrow case (i.e. conterfactual CREATE2 funding and then SELFDESTROYing it)... I think i need to look a bit more into this case, but prob will leave it to a following PR.
